scope: 已审计U卡 BIN 码与赞助行透视数据

bins.name: ether.fi Cash Visa
bins.sponsorBank: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico / Rain
bins.stripeNote: 属于美元区卡段，多方反馈可用于大部分海外订阅与云服务，支付兼容性较高。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 据社区反馈可用于常规海淘消费与部分手机钱包绑定，国内微信/支付宝兼容性需更多数据样本核对。
bins.notes: 由 ether.fi 推出，底层基础架构由 Raincards 提供；该号段同时服务 KAST、Plasma One、Tria、Ethena Pay 等项目；包含用户反馈的 45492423 号段。

en.walletMainlandNote: Community reports show it works for everyday overseas purchases and links to some mobile wallets; compatibility with WeChat Pay and Alipay in mainland China needs more data before it can be confirmed.
en.stripeNote: A USD-region BIN with consistent reports of working for most overseas subscriptions and cloud services, so payment compatibility is relatively high.
en.notes: Launched by ether.fi on Raincards infrastructure, also serving KAST, Plasma One, Tria, and Ethena Pay; covers the 45492423 range.

bins.name: RedotPay Visa Virtual
bins.stripeNote: 社群反馈绑定 ChatGPT Plus、Claude Pro 成功率极高；建议绑定真实美国免税州账单地址并保持 IP 对齐。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 社群反馈可绑定微信与支付宝；单笔 ≤200 RMB 免附加费，超 200 RMB 国内收单行加收 3% 跨境通道费。
bins.notes: RedotPay 经典主力卡段，全球商户受理度高，支持 Apple Pay 与 Google Pay 快捷绑定。

en.walletMainlandNote: Community reports it links to WeChat Pay and Alipay; transactions up to RMB 200 carry no surcharge, while domestic acquirers add a 3% cross-border channel fee above that.
en.stripeNote: Community reports a very high success rate for ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro; a real US tax-free-state billing address with a matching IP is recommended.
en.notes: RedotPay’s long-standing main BIN, widely accepted by merchants worldwide, and supports adding to Apple Pay and Google Pay.

bins.name: RedotPay Visa Physical & Virtual
bins.typeLabel: 实体/虚拟白金借记卡 (Platinum Debit)
bins.stripeNote: 支持海外线上消费与 SaaS 订阅，网络认可度为欧洲/香港合规卡段标准。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持微信、支付宝、大陆线下 POS 刷卡及支持外卡的 ATM 提领法币现金。
bins.notes: RedotPay 实体卡与新批次虚拟卡段，BIN 归属清晰，支持离线挥卡闪付。

en.walletMainlandNote: Works with WeChat Pay and Alipay, with in-person POS terminals in mainland China, and with ATMs that accept foreign cards for local-currency cash.
en.stripeNote: Handles overseas online spending and SaaS subscriptions; network acceptance matches the standard for compliant European and Hong Kong BINs.
en.notes: Covers RedotPay’s physical card and its newer virtual BINs, with clear BIN attribution and contactless tap-to-pay that works offline.

bins.name: PokePay Mastercard Virtual
bins.typeLabel: 虚拟预付万事达卡 (Prepaid Mastercard)
bins.stripeNote: 可用于 OpenAI、Midjourney 扣款；因属于 Prepaid 性质，少数严格阻断预付卡的平台可能触发拒付。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持绑定微信支付与支付宝消费，便利店、外卖扫码社群反馈通过。
bins.notes: PokePay 早期主力万事达卡段，充值 USDT 自动兑换为 USD 实时入账。

en.walletMainlandNote: Links to WeChat Pay and Alipay for spending; community reports success paying by QR at convenience stores and for food delivery.
en.stripeNote: Works for OpenAI and Midjourney billing; because it is a prepaid card, the few platforms that block prepaid BINs outright may decline it.
en.notes: PokePay’s early main Mastercard BIN; USDT top-ups convert to USD and credit in real time.

bins.name: PokePay Mastercard Pro
bins.typeLabel: 万事达高级预付卡 (World Prepaid)
bins.stripeNote: 万事达 3DS 验证响应稳定，支持多数境外电商平台及 Apple Pay。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持绑定微信与支付宝消费。
bins.notes: 新版 PokePay 万事达高级卡段，额度上限较高。

en.walletMainlandNote: Links to WeChat Pay and Alipay for spending.
en.stripeNote: Mastercard 3DS responses are stable, and it works with most overseas e-commerce platforms and with Apple Pay.
en.notes: The newer PokePay premium Mastercard prepaid BIN, with a higher spending ceiling.

bins.name: BingX Card Visa
bins.typeLabel: 虚拟白金借记卡 (Visa Platinum Debit)
bins.stripeNote: 由持牌 Rain 基础设施承兑清算，Stripe 与海外主流 SaaS 商户通过率极高。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持绑定微信/支付宝快捷支付，按 Visa 跨境结算汇率入账。
bins.notes: BingX 交易所官方卡，账户资金直连，消费无需手动提前划转。

en.walletMainlandNote: Links to WeChat Pay and Alipay for quick payment, settled at Visa’s cross-border rate.
en.stripeNote: Cleared through Rain’s licensed infrastructure; pass rates with Stripe and mainstream overseas SaaS merchants are very high.
en.notes: BingX’s official exchange card; account funds are connected directly, so no manual transfer is needed before spending.

bins.name: Plasma One Visa
bins.stripeNote: 官方提供 AI 商户专属返现，完美支持 ChatGPT Plus、Claude、Cursor、Google One 等订阅。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 微信/支付宝绑定畅通，日常线下扫码与 Apple Pay 体验流畅。
bins.notes: Rain Liquidity 旗舰 Visa 卡段，同时驱动 Plasma One 与 ether.fi Cash。

en.walletMainlandNote: Links to WeChat Pay and Alipay without friction, and works smoothly for everyday in-person QR payments and Apple Pay.
en.stripeNote: The issuer offers cashback specifically for AI merchants, and it handles ChatGPT Plus, Claude, Cursor and Google One subscriptions reliably.
en.notes: Rain Liquidity’s flagship Visa BIN, backing both Plasma One and ether.fi Cash.

bins.name: Bitrefill Card Visa
bins.stripeNote: 欧洲商户接受度极佳；美区订阅如遇 3DS 验证需在 App 点击授权。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 部分外卡通道支持绑定微信，但因以欧元结算可能产生 1.5%~2% FX 汇损。
bins.notes: 由欧洲老牌礼品卡与加密支付平台 Bitrefill 发行，受欧盟法规保护。

en.walletMainlandNote: Some foreign-card channels allow linking to WeChat, but because it settles in euros it may incur a 1.5%–2% FX spread.
en.stripeNote: Excellent acceptance with European merchants; if a US subscription triggers 3DS, the authorisation has to be approved in the app.
en.notes: Issued by Bitrefill, the long-established European gift-card and crypto payment platform, under EU regulation.

bins.name: Crypto.com Visa Card
bins.stripeNote: 传统美资商业银行清算通道，美国全境及国际顶级合规商户完全畅通。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持主流国际外卡收单网络。
bins.notes: U卡领域标杆合规产品，由纽约持牌商业银行存款托管。

en.walletMainlandNote: Works across the main international card-acquiring networks.
en.stripeNote: Cleared through a traditional US commercial bank channel; works without friction across the US and with top-tier compliant merchants internationally.
en.notes: A compliance benchmark among crypto cards, with deposits held by a licensed New York commercial bank.

bins.name: Nexo Card Dual Mode Mastercard
bins.typeLabel: 双模式万事达世界之极卡 (World Elite)
bins.stripeNote: 持牌立陶宛 EMI 清算，借记/信用双模式自由切换，欧美全境畅通。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 微信与支付宝均支持国际卡快捷支付。
bins.notes: 首创借记卡与信贷额度一键切换，享受万事达最高尊贵等级待遇。

en.walletMainlandNote: Both WeChat Pay and Alipay accept international cards for quick payment.
en.stripeNote: Cleared by a licensed Lithuanian EMI with free switching between debit and credit modes; works across Europe and the US.
en.notes: The first card to switch between debit and a credit line with one tap, carrying Mastercard’s highest tier.

bins.name: Bybit Card Mastercard
bins.stripeNote: 适用于欧洲主流线上线下商户；中国大陆证件不在发卡支持名单中。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 可绑定微信/支付宝，但受欧洲发卡行境外风险控制策略约束。
bins.notes: Bybit 交易所官方发行的借记卡，仅向欧洲合规受限国家开放。

en.walletMainlandNote: Can be linked to WeChat Pay and Alipay, but is subject to the European issuer’s cross-border risk controls.
en.stripeNote: Suits mainstream European online and in-person merchants; mainland Chinese ID is not on the issuer’s supported list.
en.notes: A debit card issued by the Bybit exchange, open only to the European countries where it is cleared to operate.

bins.name: Wirex One Visa Card
bins.stripeNote: 老牌合规U卡，Contis/Solaris 银行体系托管清算。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持绑定国际卡快捷消费。
bins.notes: 已升级为 Wirex One 账户体系，支持多币种即时结算。

en.walletMainlandNote: Supports linking for quick spending as an international card.
en.stripeNote: A long-established compliant crypto card, cleared through the Contis/Solaris banking system.
en.notes: Now on the Wirex One account system, with instant multi-currency settlement.

bins.name: Gnosis Pay Visa Debit
bins.typeLabel: 自托管智能合约借记卡 (Self-Custodial Safe)
bins.stripeNote: 自托管 Safe 智能合约钱包直扣，链上 EURe 欧元代币清算。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 仅建议欧洲本地或跨境纯欧元消费场景使用。
bins.notes: 首张与以太坊链上自托管 Safe 合约直连的真实 Visa 借记卡。官方已公告消费者卡与网页应用于 2026-12-20 23:59 UTC 停止服务，新注册早已关闭；发卡方 Monavate。

en.walletMainlandNote: Only advisable for local European spending or for purely euro-denominated cross-border payments.
en.stripeNote: Debited directly from a self-custodial Safe smart-contract wallet and settled on-chain in the EURe euro token.
en.notes: The first real Visa debit card wired directly to a self-custodial Safe contract on Ethereum. The issuer has announced that the consumer card and web app stop at 23:59 UTC on 2026-12-20, and new sign-ups closed long ago; the issuer is Monavate.

bins.name: DuPay Mastercard (Standard)
bins.typeLabel: 标准万事达预付卡 (Prepaid Mastercard)
bins.stripeNote: 因被大量脚本批量薅羊毛，Stripe Radar 拒付率较高；绑定 OpenAI 建议多切换干净 IP 尝试。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 可绑定微信与支付宝，单笔超 200 RMB 加收 3% 跨境通道费。
bins.notes: DuPay 当前主力万事达预付卡段，存在一定风控磨损，请勿囤积过多充值余额。

en.walletMainlandNote: Can be linked to WeChat Pay and Alipay; transactions above RMB 200 carry a 3% cross-border channel fee.
en.stripeNote: Heavily abused by scripted sign-up farming, so Stripe Radar declines are common; when using it with OpenAI, trying different clean IPs is advisable.
en.notes: DuPay’s current main Mastercard prepaid BIN, with some risk-control wear; do not stockpile a large top-up balance on it.

bins.name: DuPay 历史代付卡段 (Legacy)
bins.sponsorBank: 第三方白标代付池 (已终止合作)
bins.stripeNote: 该卡段已被 OpenAI 与 Stripe Radar 加入永久高危黑名单，扣款直接拦截。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 已被国内收单行全面拦截。
bins.notes: 早期 DuPay 匿名免 KYC 代付卡段，因批量滥用被卡组织拔线吊销，所有卡片已作废。

en.walletMainlandNote: Blocked outright by mainland Chinese acquirers.
en.stripeNote: This BIN sits on OpenAI’s and Stripe Radar’s permanent high-risk blacklist, and charges are blocked outright.
en.notes: An early DuPay no-KYC proxy-payment BIN; mass abuse led the card network to cut it off and revoke it, and every card is void.

bins.name: BitMart Card Visa (已停服)
bins.sponsorBank: PayrNet Limited (牌照已遭立陶宛央行吊销)
bins.stripeNote: 发卡行破产清算，卡片已被 Visa 全网注销。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 已全线停服。
bins.notes: BitMart 停止运营，底层 BaaS 机构 PayrNet 暴雷注销，已收录《停服公墓》。

en.walletMainlandNote: The service is fully discontinued.
en.stripeNote: The issuing bank went into insolvency proceedings and Visa has cancelled the cards network-wide.
en.notes: BitMart ceased operating and the underlying BaaS provider PayrNet collapsed and lost its licence; recorded in the Graveyard.

bins.name: Cypher Card Visa (已停服)
bins.stripeNote: 被 Nium 收购后按公告清退，卡片已注销、BIN 码不再可用。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 已全线停服。
bins.notes: 2026-08-08 卡片关闭、2026-09-06 平台关停；官方公告为收购后清退，未提及安全事件。已收录《停服公墓》。

en.walletMainlandNote: The service is fully discontinued.
en.stripeNote: Wound down by announcement after the Nium acquisition; the cards are cancelled and the BIN is no longer usable.
en.notes: Cards closed on 2026-08-08 and the platform shut down on 2026-09-06; the official notice describes a wind-down after acquisition and mentions no security incident. Recorded in the Graveyard.

bins.name: OneKey Card (已终止发卡)
bins.typeLabel: 标准万事达预付卡 (Prepaid Mastercard)
bins.stripeNote: OneKey 官方已于 2023-2024 年正式停止虚拟卡业务。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 服务已下线。
bins.notes: 早期硬件钱包厂商试水虚拟卡，后因合规与风控风险主动关停业务。

en.walletMainlandNote: The service has been retired.
en.stripeNote: OneKey formally ended its virtual-card business during 2023–2024.
en.notes: An early hardware-wallet maker’s move into virtual cards, shut down voluntarily over compliance and risk-control concerns.

bins.name: HypPay Mastercard Virtual
bins.stripeNote: 企业级预付卡段，商业商户受理度尚可，个人订阅可能遇风控。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 微信支付宝支持绑定。
bins.notes: 多用于跨境出海广告投放与企业采购代扣。

en.walletMainlandNote: Linking to WeChat Pay and Alipay is supported.
en.stripeNote: A business-tier prepaid BIN: acceptable with commercial merchants, though personal subscriptions may run into risk controls.
en.notes: Mostly used for cross-border advertising spend and corporate procurement billing.

bins.name: Volet (Advcash) Mastercard
bins.stripeNote: 老牌离岸支付服务商，支持欧元与美元双币种清算。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 部分中国外卡通道可用。
bins.notes: 原名 Advcash，专注于离岸电子钱包与加密充值出海服务。

en.walletMainlandNote: Usable on some Chinese channels that accept foreign cards.
en.stripeNote: A long-established offshore payment provider settling in both euros and US dollars.
en.notes: Formerly Advcash, focused on offshore e-wallets and crypto-funded cross-border services.

bins.name: Tangem Pay Visa Virtual
bins.stripeNote: Rain 发行基础设施，支持主流国际线上电商与服务订阅。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 需完成 Tangem Pay 专属 Sumsub KYC。
bins.notes: Tangem 硬件钱包 App 独立支付账户，由 Rain 发行。

en.walletMainlandNote: Requires completing Tangem Pay’s Sumsub KYC.
en.stripeNote: Issued on Rain’s infrastructure and works with mainstream international online merchants and service subscriptions.
en.notes: A separate payment account inside the Tangem hardware-wallet app, issued by Rain.

bins.name: Avalanche Card Visa
bins.stripeNote: 官方明确排除中国大陆用户申请；合格地区商户受理率极高。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 发卡地区限制严格。
bins.notes: Avalanche 官方雪崩卡，支持 USDC / AVAX 质押实时扣款消费。

en.walletMainlandNote: Issuing regions are tightly restricted.
en.stripeNote: Mainland Chinese applicants are explicitly excluded; among eligible regions merchant acceptance is very high.
en.notes: Avalanche’s official card, which debits against USDC or AVAX collateral in real time.

bins.name: Wasabi / N Round Visa (历史卡段)
bins.stripeNote: 已列入国际卡组织风险黑名单。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 已全线停服。
bins.notes: 早期匿名发卡服务，底层 BaaS 暴雷后全线作废注销。

en.walletMainlandNote: The service is fully discontinued.
en.stripeNote: Listed on the international card networks’ risk blacklist.
en.notes: An early anonymous issuing service; when the underlying BaaS provider collapsed, every card was voided and cancelled.

bins.name: Sutton Bank Mastercard Corporate Purchasing
bins.stripeNote: 属于 Sutton Bank 企业采购卡段，实测可用于主流国际商户与 SaaS 订阅扣款。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持 Apple Pay 闪付；国内微信/支付宝绑定受境外企业卡政策及商户类别码限制。
bins.notes: 537100 属 Sutton Bank 企业采购卡段（非预付卡），Bitget 赴美新卡实测为 53710058，PEXX 等美元产品亦共用此卡段。需注意持卡人为企业授权用卡人而非银行员工，缺乏个人消费者保护；网络关于万事达特许批量发卡及 Gate/GoPay 同源传闻已被核实为误读。

en.walletMainlandNote: Works with Apple Pay tap-to-pay; linking to WeChat Pay and Alipay in mainland China is limited by the issuer’s corporate-card policy and by merchant category codes.
en.stripeNote: A Sutton Bank corporate purchasing BIN, tested successfully with mainstream international merchants and SaaS subscription billing.
en.notes: 537100 is a Sutton Bank corporate purchasing BIN, not a prepaid one, and the new US-facing Bitget card tests as 53710058; PEXX and affiliated USD programs share this corporate BIN. Note that the holder is an authorised user on a corporate account rather than a bank customer, so personal consumer protections do not apply; online claims of a Mastercard-licensed bulk-issuing arrangement, and of a shared origin with Gate and GoPay, were checked and are misreadings.

bins.name: Ethena Pay Visa (Rain)
bins.stripeNote: Rain 核心美元卡段，多方实测支持 OpenAI ChatGPT、Claude、海外 SaaS 订阅扣款。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持绑定 Apple Pay 与 Google Pay 碰一碰闪付，支持微信/支付宝绑定消费。
bins.notes: Raincards 核心发行号段之一，支撑 Ethena Pay、KAST、Tria 等主流加密卡产品。

en.walletMainlandNote: Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay tap-to-pay; links to WeChat Pay and Alipay for everyday retail spending.
en.stripeNote: Core USD BIN from Raincards with verified high acceptance for OpenAI ChatGPT, Claude, and overseas SaaS subscriptions.
en.notes: One of Raincards primary issuance ranges, powering Ethena Pay, KAST, Tria, and affiliated programs.

bins.name: Jupiter Card Visa (Rain)
bins.stripeNote: Raincards 主力美元卡段，支持海外 SaaS 与主流电商支付。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 原生支持 Apple Pay 与 Google Pay，支持国际商户闪付与线上刷卡。
bins.notes: Raincards 旗下核心号段，服务 Jupiter、Oobit、XPlace 等生态应用。

en.walletMainlandNote: Native support for Apple Pay and Google Pay; widely accepted at international contactless terminals.
en.stripeNote: Raincards mainstream USD range with dependable authorization rates across global e-commerce and SaaS platforms.
en.notes: Core Raincards infrastructure serving Jupiter, Oobit, XPlace, and related Web3 wallet integrations.

bins.name: Lava Card Visa (Rain)
bins.stripeNote: 美元卡段，支持海外常见订阅与数字商品结算。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持 Apple Pay 手机闪付，支持微信、支付宝扫码绑定。
bins.notes: Raincards 旗下美元卡段，服务 Lava、Peanut、Avici、Hyperbeat 及 Kolo 美元卡。

en.walletMainlandNote: Supports Apple Pay contactless mobile payments; compatible with WeChat Pay and Alipay binding.
en.stripeNote: USD card range with reliable approval rates across digital services and recurring global subscriptions.
en.notes: Raincards USD BIN range supporting Lava, Peanut, Avici, Hyperbeat, and Kolo USD cards.

bins.name: Wirex & COCA Visa (Wirex Pay)
bins.stripeNote: 欧洲与英国合规号段，支持欧元区与全球非美元消费结算。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 原生支持 Apple Pay 与 Google Pay 碰一碰闪付。
bins.notes: 由 Wirex Pay 模块化 BaaS 赋能，服务 Wirex、COCA、Pulsar Money 与 Kolo 欧元卡。

en.walletMainlandNote: Native tap-to-pay integration with Apple Pay and Google Pay across in-person contactless terminals.
en.stripeNote: UK/EEA regulated debit range with clean compliance routing for European and global multi-currency spending.
en.notes: Powered by Wirex Pay modular BaaS infrastructure, backing Wirex, COCA, Pulsar Money, and Kolo EUR programs.

bins.name: Wirex Mastercard (Global)
bins.typeLabel: 万事达多币种借记卡 (Mastercard Debit)
bins.stripeNote: Wirex 旗下国际万事达卡段，全球主流商户接受度良好。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持 Apple Pay 闪付与国际收单商户消费。
bins.notes: Wirex 主力国际万事达卡段，支持多法币与加密货币余额即时扣划。

en.walletMainlandNote: Compatible with Apple Pay provisioning and international POS terminals globally.
en.stripeNote: Global Mastercard BIN from Wirex with standard approval rates across mainstream e-commerce merchants.
en.notes: Primary international Mastercard program by Wirex supporting multi-fiat and crypto balance debiting.

bins.name: Wirex Visa (Transact Payments Malta)
bins.typeLabel: 欧洲区 Visa 借记卡 (Visa Debit)
bins.stripeNote: 马耳他持牌 EMI 发卡，欧洲经济区（EEA）合规资质完备。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 原生支持欧洲与全球 Apple Pay、Google Pay 闪付。
bins.notes: 由马耳他持牌机构 Transact Payments Malta 发行，专供 Wirex 欧洲居民客户。

en.walletMainlandNote: Native integration with Apple Pay and Google Pay across European and overseas terminals.
en.stripeNote: Licensed Maltese EMI issuance providing full European regulatory compliance and stable authorization rates.
en.notes: Issued by Transact Payments Malta Limited for Wirex verified European Economic Area (EEA) cardholders.

bins.name: Kraken Mastercard (Monavate)
bins.stripeNote: 欧洲顶级交易所合规卡段，机构信誉极高，防欺诈拒付率极低。
bins.walletMainlandNote: 支持 Apple Pay 与 Google Pay 闪付，支持境外与境内外卡 POS 交易。
bins.notes: Kraken 官方发卡底座，由英国/欧洲持牌 EMI 机构 Monavate 提供合规赞助。
